hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: In each operation we remove the smallest element from the array.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Every element strictly less than k must be removed.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Count how many elements in nums are strictly less than k.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass counting elements below threshold k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly sorting or heap-popping takes O(n log n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that all numbers smaller than k must be removed, leading to a linear scan.
